description.value: Prairie Donair is a Canadian fast-food franchise specialising in donairs, shawarma, rice bowls, salads, and poutines, with a strong emphasis on fresh toppings and customisable build-your-own options. The White Rock branch sits on Marine Drive, the waterfront road that is a natural cycling corridor along the south shore of BC. The chain markets itself as a healthier alternative to conventional fast food, offering a wide protein range including beef, chicken, lamb, and falafel.
